title: SessionCreateRequest
description: Body of `POST /v1/sessions`. All fields optional; unknown fields are refused with 400.

allOf.description: Engine a session is pinned to for its whole life. Scrapes on the session run on this engine; `fingerprint` is only valid with `camoufox`.

engine.description: Engine `camoufox` is coming soon. Engine to pin. Case-insensitive. Omitted means the first of `obscura`, `chromium` that this deployment runs, else `fetch`. Choose explicitly if you need a browser-only feature such as localStorage.

ttl_seconds.description: Sliding lifetime in seconds. Omitted or 0 means 1800, reduced to the organization maximum with a warning if that is lower. Values above the organization maximum (default 604800, i.e. 7 days) are refused with 400 naming the real maximum.

sticky_key.description: Coming soon. Pins the exit IP across the session. Letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. Omitted means derived from the session id (still pinned). Must be unique among active sessions in the project. Cannot be combined with `rotate_ip`.

region_pool.description: Coming soon. Regional exit pool to draw from. Trimmed; longer than 64 characters is refused.

rotate_ip.description: Coming soon. Keep the cookie jar but let the exit IP change between requests. Use for many-page crawls; avoid for replayed logins, which get challenged on a moving IP. Refused together with `sticky_key`.

premium_proxy.description: Coming soon. Use the residential tier instead of datacenter. Same meaning as on `/v1/scrape`.

proxy_country.description: Coming soon. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 exit country, case-insensitive. Requires `premium_proxy: true`, otherwise 400 `ERR::REQUEST::INCOMPATIBLE_FLAGS`.

fingerprint.description: Camoufox fingerprint pin, stored verbatim. A non-empty object with any engine other than `camoufox` is refused with 400. `null` and `{}` count as absent.

domain_scores.description: Seed per-domain health, keyed by lowercase registrable domain (e.g. `example.com`). Scores must be non-negative. Above 64 entries, the least useful (unblocked, lowest score, oldest) are evicted rather than refused.

additionalProperties.description: One domain's standing with the session. At a score of 3 or with `retired` true, the session is treated as blocked for that domain.

score.description: Error score; rises on failures, decays on successes. Blocked at 3.

retired.description: Hard, sticky block for this domain (e.g. a 403 wall). Does not decay; use a new session for this domain.

allOf.description: Everything a browser holds that makes it logged in. Maps and arrays are never null in responses.

items.description: One cookie in stored spelling (`http_only`, `same_site`), not CDP spelling.

domain.description: Cookie domain; a leading dot (".example.com") makes it domain-wide and is preserved. Required.

expires.description: Expiry in seconds since the epoch (CDP units). Omit for a session cookie. Zero or negative values (such as CDP's -1) are treated as a session cookie and omitted.

secure.description: Secure flag. Required to be true when `same_site` is `None`.

same_site.description: SameSite attribute in exact CDP casing. Omit when unset; it is not defaulted. `None` without `secure: true` is refused.

local_storage.description: Origin (bare `http(s)://host[:port]`, no path) to key/value map. At most 100 origins and 1000 keys per origin.

session_storage.description: Same shape and limits as `local_storage`. Many single-page apps keep access tokens here; include it when importing a login.

indexed_db.description: Origin to list of IndexedDB databases, each carried verbatim as JSON. At most 50 origins and 50 databases per origin. Treat as opaque.

session_context.description: Initial cookies and storage, e.g. an existing login or the `session_context` from a previous `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/context`. Serialised size limit 1 MiB (413). Omitted means an empty context.
